description: When the SIS closes a soft link for higher priority traffic to another node, the U_PDU still queued on the closed link is rejected with Soft Link Terminated for higher priority link, the reason the SIS gave for the close.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with node delivery confirmation at 0; cas.max_links is 1. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215); the SIS of the called node declares the soft link established (A-0194), knowing from C_PHYSICAL_LINK_MADE that it is the called node (A-0325). The minimum hold is set to 0, so none runs (A-0326), and the idle and maximum times to 3600000, so sis.soft_link_max/0.0.1.3 and sis.soft_link_idle/0.0.1.3 start but never fall due here; the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0322). At 61000 the peer's first DATA C_PDU arrives, a DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) with 'ping' for SAP 9, which no client has bound, so the SIS discards it (A-0235); cas.first_data stops (B-0215, B-0403). At 62000 the burst ends with an acknowledgement owed: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and 12000 ms of contention; at 78000 the ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 1, 15 bytes, 1 block) goes out, ending at 83550. At 85000 conn 1 sends two ARQ U_PDUs in one write. The first, 'data' (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0), goes down on the soft link as an ARQ C_PDU and dts.ttd runs to its TTD; it is outstanding (A-0320). The second, 'high' (priority 15, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.4), has no soft link: the SIS holds it and asks for a physical link, which the CAS refuses locally with Maximum Physical Links In Use (B-0025, B-0402), so the SIS holds off (B-0028). The open link carries only priority 0, below the 15 waiting, so the SIS closes it at once with Soft Link Terminated for higher priority link, priority 15 (A-0205, A-0323, B-0172). The CAS stops new C_PDUs on the link (B-0241, B-0246): 'data' has not started, so it is held, and the link is clean, so the CAS goes straight to Step 1 (B-0278, B-0317): link_state breaking, then LBT 3000 after our own transmission (K-0074) and contention. PHYSICAL LINK BREAK goes out at 133000 with reason 3, Higher Priority, as B-0302 maps it (octet 43), our C_PDU ID 1; cas.break from 138550. At 146000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM: cas.break stops and link_state unlinked (B-0286). The connection has ended, so the DTS rejects 'data' (C-0652, C-0866) and dts.ttd, with nothing left, is cancelled. The link has closed, so the held-off peer asks again (B-0412): link_state calling for 0.0.1.4. The rejection is due to the soft link close, so its reason is the one the SIS gave (A-0206, A-0207, A-0324), and since 'data' asked for confirmation conn 1 gets S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_REJECTED with reason 9, Soft Link Terminated for higher priority link (A-0105, A-0107), SAP 9 and 0.0.1.3 as asked (A-0109, A-0110), and the whole U_PDU (A-0111). The burst ends at 147000 with the request queued: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then 36000 ms of contention; PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4, our C_PDU ID 2) goes out at 187000 and cas.link_request/0.0.1.4 starts at 192550 (B-0203, B-0400). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10 for 1 block to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node), 0.0.1.3 and 0.0.1.4 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). P6-1: the 'data' U_PDU asked for confirmation; handed to the CAS at 85000 with sis.confirm_wait_ms unset, its wait runs to its TTD, so sis.confirm_wait starts then; the 'high' U_PDU held for 0.0.1.4 has the same deadline behind it, so its rejection's end of wait changes nothing (interp A-0232, A-0342). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
